correction_metadata.title: POLARIS EMS Objective Governance Wording Correction

corrected_claim.removed_invalid_statement: The optimizer will consume up to 4,000 Liters of diesel fuel to prevent a single kWh of unmet critical load.
corrected_claim.governed_statement: The unmet-load penalty is 16,000 times the marginal diesel-energy cost on a $/kWh basis. The realized fuel required to avoid a unit of unmet load depends on generator operating constraints, base fuel consumption, startup costs, battery state, renewable availability, curtailment, objective discounting, horizon dynamics, and overall feasibility.
corrected_claim.governed_clarification: The 16,000:1 value is therefore an objective-cost coefficient ratio, not a claim that the optimizer will literally burn a fixed quantity of diesel to avoid one kWh of unmet load.
